## Architecture decision

<a id="EffectsFollowTheRequest"></a>

### Effects follow the request

`EffectsFollowTheRequest` · `src/architecture.ts:203` · status: **held**

What an entry point may do follows what it is asked: a read changes nothing, a utility touches nothing, and a call to the payment provider is verified by a scenario before it reaches a driver.

Context: A driver who reads a reservation must never pay for it, and a refund must never be sent untested.

Consequences: Three rules judge the effects of every entry point and function at each build.

- Decided by: karim
- Serves: [Cancel without stress](cancellation.md#CancelWithoutStress)
- Applied by: [A read writes nothing](#ReadWithoutWrite), [Utilities do not touch the world](#UtilitiesWithoutWorld), [Every call to a third party is verified](#ThirdPartiesVerified)

## Architecture rules

<a id="ReadWithoutWrite"></a>

### A read writes nothing

`ReadWithoutWrite` · `src/architecture.ts:167` · status: **held**

A GET writes neither to the database nor to a third party, not even through a distant dependency.

Respected everywhere.

<details><summary>Its parameters</summary>

```typescript
{
    nodes: { kinds: [KindName.entry], where: [{ path: `${fieldsOf(entryKind).trigger}.type`, equals: TriggerType.http }, { path: `${fieldsOf(entryKind).trigger}.method`, equals: "GET" }] },
    effects: ["write", "third-party"],
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: karim
- Applies: [Effects a node may not have](../../../std/docs/rules.md#WithoutEffects), [Effects follow the request](#EffectsFollowTheRequest)

<a id="ThirdPartiesVerified"></a>

### Every call to a third party is verified

`ThirdPartiesVerified` · `src/architecture.ts:192` · status: **held**

An entry point that calls a third party has at least one scenario that verifies it.

Respected everywhere.

<details><summary>Its parameters</summary>

```typescript
{ nodes: { kinds: [KindName.entry], effects: ["third-party"] }, edge: edgesOf(scenarioKind).verifies, way: "in", atLeast: 1 }
```

</details>

- Owner: karim
- Applies: [As many links as asked](../../../std/docs/rules.md#Linked), [Effects follow the request](#EffectsFollowTheRequest)

<a id="UtilitiesWithoutWorld"></a>

### Utilities do not touch the world

`UtilitiesWithoutWorld` · `src/architecture.ts:182` · status: **held**

A utility function neither reads nor writes the database, and does not call the network. Reading the time is allowed. A function that answers a port (a repository over the database port) is not a utility: it is a realization, chosen by a technical choice.

Respected everywhere.

<details><summary>Its parameters</summary>

```typescript
{ nodes: { kinds: [KindName.function], without: { edge: EdgeName.implements } }, effects: ["read", "write", "network", "third-party"] }
```

</details>

- Owner: karim
- Applies: [Effects a node may not have](../../../std/docs/rules.md#WithoutEffects), [Effects follow the request](#EffectsFollowTheRequest)
